scope: Zero-training diagnostic and figure generation only; no independent confirmation set.

scenario_selection.metric: DEV per-parent mean across five Hybrid seeds of E_S(Hybrid)-E_S(UNet-Tail)
scenario_selection.seed: seed 67, fixed by median DEV E_U among seeds
scenario_selection.inference: rerun inference only for the three selected parents after verifying all required checkpoints and source/data bindings.

inputs_required: parent-level DEV E_S values for all five Hybrid seeds and UNet-Tail
same-parent observed/reference and outputs for Stage1, Hybrid, UNet-Tail, RSDR-Net, Max-TF
complex time-series outputs and range-Doppler inputs for selected three parents

figures.fig6: per-parent five-seed means: E_U and E_S stage-delta histograms; |g-1|^2 versus shape-error changes across stages
figures.fig5: repeat in main text; direct and cyclic in supplement; real waveforms, pulse-compression magnitude with shared absolute-power reference, and RD maps for Final, UNet-Tail, RSDR-Net

statistical_rule: five Hybrid seeds averaged within scene; quantile parent selection on DEV; no substitute seed or parent; preserve raw complex outputs on Server B only.
failure_handling: If any required paired parent-level data, checkpoint identity, or method output is absent, record the exact missing item and stop that figure component. Do not use aggregate-only summaries as waveform evidence.
